title: Initial Exploration of Zero-Shot Privacy Utility Tradeoffs in Tabular Data Using GPT-4

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring group fairness metrics (Equalized Odds, Equalized Opportunity, and Demographic Parity) on downstream machine learning classifiers trained on GPT-4 sanitized tabular data, where gender is designated as the sensitive/private attribute (Task 1).

Measuring group fairness metrics (Equalized Odds, Equalized Opportunity, and Demographic Parity) on downstream machine learning classifiers trained on the sanitized dataset, where income level is designated as the sensitive/private attribute (Task 2).
